name: 08804 · Bloomsbury, NJ
findings: ZIP 08804 (Bloomsbury) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (82%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08804 (Bloomsbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
